display_name: outer band / exit midcross / regime off
thesis: Round 37 cell: the single-band control, outer band only; it exits when the outer band's midline is lost; the 200-day regime filter is OFF. One cell of a pre-registered 3 x 2 x 2 factorial asking a single question: on daily bars, does the two-band structure earn anything the single band does not? The hypothesis is taken from this programme's own persona corpus -- the influencer `creator-e` ('Creator E') describes a 'Double B' system across several notes (`VIDEOID002`, `-VIDEOID001`, `VIDEOID003`) using exactly these two band configurations, 1% risk per trade and stops moved to break-even. HIS CLAIM IS INTRADAY -- 1-minute and 2-minute candles in the first two hours after a session open -- AND THIS ROUND DOES NOT TEST IT AND CANNOT. It asks the only question this programme's daily-bar engine can ask of the idea: whether the band-within-band structure carries anything at daily frequency against the programme's own trend-form family, which rounds 17, 18 and 34 measured as entirely inside a 21.2 percentage point noise floor. The nearest existing form is `band-breakout`, a SINGLE band. The universe is NVDA TSM MU AMD QCOM MSFT GOOGL AMZN NFLX ORCL INTC TXN -- `app.evolution.universe._TAXABLE_GROWTH` verbatim, the pool the evolution loop already searches, so this is a form the loop cannot emit tested on names it already trades, and not a universe picked by the author to suit a band strategy. Every parameter is quoted rather than tuned: 20/2 and 4/4 are the persona's own published numbers, 200 is rounds 17/18/34's regime period, the 12% stop is round 17's middle bracket level (published as differing from its neighbours by 0.14pp across 48 cells), and the 150-session hold cap sits inside the nine-month trading mandate rather than at its edge. Nothing will be promoted from this round: it is a measurement study, and `PROTOCOL.md` section 9's r21 amendment already removes the `trading` purpose from section 6's promotion rule -- these medians are reported and never promoted on. Not investment advice; this is not an endorsement of the persona's system and produces no evidence about the win rates his notes claim. See `strategy-program/ROUND-37-PLAN.md` for the pre-registration, the decision rule and the six falsifiable predictions.
falsification: This cell is the single-band control and its thesis is that the 20-period, 2-sigma break is the whole of whatever a band entry earns. It is falsified if this cell's worst adjusted excess is not in `chop-2011` or `chop-2015` -- a breakout rule in a directionless market is supposed to buy the failed break repeatedly, and if that is not where it hurts, the form's exposure is not what it claims. This cell exits on the outer band's midline, so a losing trade is one the outer-band regime survived while the position bled. This cell is the regime-filter-removed half of its pair, so it also falsifies the claim that the 200-day filter is load-bearing: if the two regime marginals differ by less than 21.2pp while the filter halves held capital, the filter is a position sizer spelled as an entry condition -- round 34's finding, replicating on a third universe. The round-level falsification, which this cell contributes one observation to, is in `strategy-program/ROUND-37-PLAN.md` section 5: the two-band structure is declared to matter only if the `double` marginal beats the `outer` marginal by more than 21.2 percentage points, with the same sign in at least five of the eight main windows, AND the contrast survives Benjamini-Hochberg at q < 0.10 over every one of the twelve cells run. Anything less is the null.
